title.zh: MultiversX restarts after exploit halt, but Kraken still bars new EGLD trades

current_state.zh: MultiversX brought its mainnet back online after a roughly five-day exploit-related halt following a recovery upgrade, while Kraken continued to restrict EGLD to cancel-only trading with deposits and withdrawals paused.

updates.background_zh: MultiversX于9月19日表示，针对虚拟机原子性问题的未遂攻击导致了无效状态变更，并促使网络暂停推进；9月24日的技术更新称工程团队已完成恢复检查。MultiversX于2020年上线主网，其原生代币EGLD（“eGold”，前身为ERD）用于质押、奖励验证者以及在网络上存储和转移价值。
updates.background_en: MultiversX said on Sept. 19 that an attempted exploit of a virtual-machine atomicity issue had caused invalid state changes and prompted a pause in network progression; the Sept. 24 technical update said engineering had completed recovery checks. MultiversX launched its mainnet in 2020 and its native cryptocurrency, EGLD ("eGold"), formerly ERD, is used for staking, rewarding validators, and storing and transferring value on the network.
updates.market_impact_zh: EGLD在交易所层面的流动性目前被分割：在Kraken限制新订单并暂停EGLD充提的情况下，交易与资金流动被限制在其他交易所以及MultiversX称已恢复的链上活动中。尚未解决的变量是Kraken何时恢复交易与充提，因为其公告决定了EGLD能否进出该平台。
updates.market_impact_en: EGLD's exchange-level liquidity is currently segmented: with Kraken restricting new orders and pausing EGLD deposits and withdrawals, trading and funding flows are confined to other venues and to on-chain activity, which MultiversX says has resumed. The unresolved variable is when Kraken restores trading and funding, since its notice governs whether EGLD can move in and out of that venue.
